title: Beyond Metrics: Evaluating LLMs’ Effectiveness in Culturally Nuanced, Low-Resource Real-World Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative evaluation of sentiment analysis F1 scores and qualitative assessment of model justifications across high-resource (English) and low-resource/code-mixed languages (Swahili, Sheng) to identify performance disparities.

Qualitative, ethnomethodologically-informed analysis of LLM-generated explanations to evaluate the models' ability to understand and incorporate cultural subtleties, local context, and colloquial slang in real-world Kenyan WhatsApp conversations.
